glosses: to tweet (utter a succession of chirps)

examples.text: In den ouden kastanjeboom zat 'n vink, die twitterde, zingen wou van lentepret; lief-onbeholpen stiet ie de nootjes uit het vroolijke bekje in de morgenlucht, die de fijne geuren droeg van de maartviooltjes.
examples.translation: In the old chestnut tree sat a finch, which tweeted, wanted to sing for the joy of spring; sweetly and clumsily he thrust the nuts from its cheerful beak into the morning air, which carried the fine scents of the March violets.
examples.english: In the old chestnut tree sat a finch, which tweeted, wanted to sing for the joy of spring; sweetly and clumsily he thrust the nuts from its cheerful beak into the morning air, which carried the fine scents of the March violets.

examples.text: Boven op de ladder ga ik zitten en vermaak me met een paar uitgevlogen koolmezen, die midden in de morel zitten te twitteren.
examples.translation: I'm sitting atop the ladder and amuse myself with a couple of fledged great tits, which are tweeting in the middle of the cherry tree.
examples.english: I'm sitting atop the ladder and amuse myself with a couple of fledged great tits, which are tweeting in the middle of the cherry tree.

glosses: actief gebruik maken van de internetdienst X, vroeger Twitter geheten
